edits.old: Per detector: equal-event MUC-AUC0.40 of score-only ordering, the ordering-free attainable bound, event recall over scoreable events, the chance event recall expected under a label-independent Bernoulli flag model at the realized nominal flag rate p (share of flagged windows among valid test windows overlapping no labeled segment): mean over scoreable events of 1 - (1 - p)^(n_e), n_e = the event's count of valid overlapping test windows; episode count, false-alarm and non-event-labeled episode counts; window AUROC/AP against event-window labels; the corrected event-wise precision, recall and F0.5 of VOR Eq. 1-2 in the time domain (below). 10 pairs of test events overlap in time; an episode overlapping two events is matched to at most one event by the one-to-one matching, and the count of episodes overlapping more than one event is reported.
edits.new: Per detector: equal-event MUC-AUC0.40 of score-only ordering, the ordering-free attainable bound, event recall over scoreable events, the chance event recall expected under a label-independent Bernoulli flag model at the realized nominal flag rate p (share of flagged windows among valid test windows overlapping no labeled segment): mean over scoreable events of 1 - (1 - p)^(n_e), n_e = the event's count of valid overlapping test windows; episode count, false-alarm and non-event-labeled episode counts; window AUROC/AP against event-window labels; the corrected event-wise precision, recall and F0.5 of VOR Eq. 1-2 in the time domain (below). 10 pairs of test events overlap in time; an episode overlapping two events is matched to at most one event by the one-to-one matching, and the count of episodes overlapping more than one event is reported. Window AUROC/AP: positives are valid test windows overlapping a scoreable event; negatives are all other valid test windows outside gap segments, which in S_L includes windows of test events that touch no lightweight channel.

edits.old: On a bounded smoke subset (all 58 primary channels, grid restricted to 2006-07-01 .. 2007-06-30, all six detector families, one replicate), every pre-evaluation artifact must be byte-identical across three label tables: (a) the true table, (b) the true table with every test-period row removed, (c) the true table with the test-period rows' Channel values and (StartTime, EndTime) pairs shuffled among the test-period rows as whole values (a pair is never split). Compared artifacts: the output files of every prep, stdz, fit, episodes and attr_episode unit of the smoke run (standardized features, masks, statistics, fitted models, validation and test scores, threshold, flags, episodes, tau, peak and aggregated masses). Checkpoint JSON files, logs and heartbeat files carry timestamps and are excluded as provenance, not as evidence. QUARANTINE: the smoke's scores, thresholds, flag rates, episode counts and masses are hash-recorded in the freeze package and are not inspected by anyone before the freeze; PT1 reports only hashes and pass/fail.
